title: Delivery Charges and Installment Plans: Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Billing Manual
content:
## Reimbursement and Billing Manual — Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program

### Delivery charges and interest-free payment plans

**1.** The delivery-charge adjustment takes charges for delivery off the plan balance: when the program carries expedited shipping charges, their total is taken off; when it carries no expedited shipping charge but carries standard shipping charges, their total is taken off; otherwise nothing is taken off.

**2.** The plan balance meant is the balance an interest-free payment plan on a Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program enrollment spreads over its monthly installments; the total this section takes off is deducted from it.

**3.** The charges meant are the patient charges posted on the enrollment whose charge type is expedited shipping or standard shipping. *Their total* is the sum of every such charge of that type posted on the enrollment.

**4.** Only one type is ever taken off. Where the enrollment carries at least one expedited shipping charge, the expedited shipping charges are taken off and any standard shipping charges remain in the plan balance. Standard shipping charges are taken off only where no expedited shipping charge is posted on the enrollment.

**5.** Patient charges of any other charge type — the self-pay price, a non-covered item — are not delivery charges and are not taken off under this section.

| Expedited shipping charges posted | Standard shipping charges posted | Taken off the plan balance |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | any, or none | the total of the expedited shipping charges |
| none | one or more | the total of the standard shipping charges |
| none | none | nothing, 0.00 |

**Hypothetical cases** (figures invented to show the clause)

- Two expedited shipping charges of 24.95 each and one standard shipping charge of 9.95 are posted: 49.90 is taken off the plan balance; the 9.95 stays in.
- Two standard shipping charges of 9.95 each and no expedited shipping charge are posted: 19.90 is taken off.
- Only self-pay price charges are posted: nothing is taken off.
